An '''iced Trammistan chocolate donut''' was a type of [[Doughnut/Legends|donut]]. It was iced with [[Trammistan chocolate]] and was served at the [[Restaurant/Legends|restaurant]] [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. There, the donuts were made in a traditional [[Adarian/Legends|Adarian]] style by a genuine [[Crisp-E-O donut droid]] every [[Time/Legends|morning]]. They cost 1.5 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]. According to the diner's owner, [[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster]], the iced Trammistan chocolate donuts were a crowd-pleasing favorite.<ref name="Dex" />

==Behind the scenes==
Iced Trammistan chocolate donuts were mentioned in "[[Dining at Dex's]]," a [[2009]] [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]]-exclusive article which was written by [[Gregory Walker]] and formatted as an [[in-universe]] menu.<ref name="Dex" /> Walker included a reference to "Adarian-stlye donuts" due to his fondness for abandoned concepts,<ref name="Blog">{{Blog|narbflick|11|Dining at Dex's: The Story Behind the Story}}</ref> as Adarians were created for the [[1983]] film [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']] but were cut from the final movie.<ref name="Insider">{{InsiderCite|67|The Ultimate Return of the Jedi Insider's Guide|The Ultimate ''Return of the Jedi'' Insider's Guide}}</ref>
